rows.label: tlk70000069_02_msg0001
rows.name:
We think there's still a lot of
treasure sleeping here in Dana Desert.

rows.label: tlk70000069_02_msg0002
rows.name:
So next time, we're thinking of hiring
an adventurer who's good at mining to
help us search.

rows.label: tlk70000069_02_msg0003
rows.name:
You guys had a Blade that was
good at mining, didn't you?

rows.label: tlk70000069_02_msg0004
rows.name:
Then you'll find treasure
not just in this desert, but
in many other places too.

rows.label: tlk70000069_02_msg0005
rows.name:
If I find any treasure before
you, though, don't think I'm
just going to hand it over!

rows.label: tlk70000069_02_msg0006
rows.name:
First come, first served, fair and
square. No hard feelings!
